technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with strong volume and Hull MA confirmation offset by weak trend strength, negative MACD histogram, and price below 200-day MA; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MMM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 57 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal for MMM; mixed congressional activity (one sale, one purchase 60-101 days ago), neutral market fear/greed, and unavailable news sentiment provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 93 crisis regime, rising USD) creates severe headwinds for MMM; earnings in 57 days adds moderate event risk but secondary to acute market dysfunction.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull MA flip-up with 15x volume spike and bullish OBV provide technical confirmation of momentum reversal near support (76.32), offering defined risk entry for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment in crisis (VIX 93, inverted yield curve, USD headwind), price below 200-day MA, negative MACD histogram, weak ADX (18.3), zero fundamental catalysts, and earnings risk in 57 days create overwhelming headwinds that outweigh technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows Hull MA flip with 15x volume spike near support, but macro environment in crisis (VIX 93, inverted yield curve, USD headwind) and price below 200-day MA create overwhelming headwinds that negate swing entry merit.
decision.primary_risk: Macro dysfunction (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis regime) will likely override technical signals; earnings in 57 days add event risk that conflicts with swing timeframe.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding MMM with 8 other Industrials positions (17% sector concentration); skip preserves capital and reduces concentration risk in unfavourable macro regime.
